title: Little Travel Book: choose the world
question: Four artistic directions for the little travel book. Keep one or two to branch in round 2, merge two, or re-roll.

options.label: The Sampler
options.thesis: Every saved place is a stitch; her hearts get sewn into a sampler she sends back.
options.viewport: The title worked large in cross stitch on mauve linen, places as stitched rows with ghost-printed hearts, a needle and thread at the foot that lengthens with each pick.
options.risk: Embroidery can tip into twee or grandmotherly if the scale is timid.

raised.raise: Unlit is designed too: empty hearts and filters show their printed ghost pattern on the cloth.
Motion obeys the material: stitches go in true stitch order and thread pulls taut, never springs.
Every list its own labeled spool: all 28 lists visible in a spool rack, friends' lists on their own rack.
One bolt of cloth: map, list and sheets are the same linen, no boxed white cards.
Each heart visibly changes the object in one stroke: the thread lengthens, a row appears on her sampler.
Zones named literally on woven sew-in labels: Places, Map, Shows, Your picks.

options.label: Photo Booth Sticker Sheet
options.thesis: The book is a purikura sheet: places are die-cut stickers, her hearts are puffy stickers, her picks print as a photo strip.
options.viewport: A sticker backing sheet with the title as a bubbly sticker stamp, places stuck askew with doodles, a peeling picks tab.
options.risk: The most familiar cute answer; can read Sanrio-clone or childish, and there are no place photos to fill the frames.

options.label: Par Avion
options.thesis: He mailed her a letter of places; each is a stamp, her heart is a wax seal, and her picks are the letter she writes back.
options.viewport: An airmail sheet with a rose-mauve chevron edge, places as perforated stamps, an envelope at the foot that fills with her stamps.
options.risk: Post and letter worlds can read vintage or wedding-invitation if the colour is timid.

options.label: Two-Ink Zine
options.lineage: risograph zines from the zine-fest table
options.thesis: A two-ink riso zine of his places: rose and mauve overprint, hand-numbered listings, a rubber-stamp heart and a tear-off order form for her picks.
options.viewport: A huge misregistered two-ink title cropped by the page edge, numbered listings with stamp hearts, a circled picks count.
options.risk: Graphic and loud; can read cool-hipster rather than romantic unless the hand-drawn warmth carries it.

options.label: Seven-Segment Clock
options.thesis: Places and showtimes as lit segments on a night-black panel.
options.viewport: A segment panel counting picks and show dates.
options.risk: Cold and mechanical for a romantic gift.
options.case: Fuses poorly: she does not identify with an appliance display, and a segment mask hurts place names.
options.kept: Unlit states designed as carefully as lit ones.

options.label: Suminagashi Ink Basin
options.thesis: The map as a marbled ink surface she stirs.
options.viewport: A fluid basin with places as ink drops.
options.risk: Beautiful but blurs locations; heavy on a mid-range phone.
options.case: Loses clarity (places must be findable) and phone performance.
options.kept: Motion that obeys a real material law.

options.label: Cassette Deck Fascia
options.thesis: Filters as chrome toggles on a brushed aluminium deck.
options.viewport: A deck panel of labeled switches.
options.risk: Reads as gear, not a gift.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hi-fi gear is the opposite of warm and cute.
options.kept: Every function gets its own labeled control: all 28 lists visible.

options.label: Op-Art Textile
options.thesis: A seamless black-and-white wave field the site slides across.
options.viewport: A continuous wave field with active regions.
options.risk: Dizzying and colourless; drops his palette.
options.case: Loses both: optical stress is the opposite of a cosy browse, and it cannot carry the palette.
options.kept: One continuous surface with no seams or boxed panels.

options.label: Forge and Hammer
options.thesis: Each action struck like a hammer blow on hot iron.
options.viewport: A forge-dark page with glowing work.
options.case: Loses both: wrong emotional world for a romantic gift.
options.kept: Each action visibly changes the object in one stroke.

options.label: Industrial Quote Labels
options.thesis: Every zone named in quoted industrial caps with hazard stripes.
options.risk: Ironic and cool where the brief asks for warm.
options.case: Loses both: irony and hazard stripes fight romance and the owner's no-caps taste.
options.kept: Wayfinding by literal labels: zones named plainly.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean map app: full-bleed map, bottom sheet list, pill filters, a pink heart.
canonCard.viewport: Map on top, draggable list sheet, chips for lists, heart on each row.
canonCard.risk: Works instantly and looks like every saved-places app; nothing hand-made.
